parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage furniture, made of plywood with a rectangular shape and internal compartments.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the internal storage compartments, ensuring stability and durability of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a flat MDF panel attached to the front of the cabinet, typically with a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet and protects the contents from dust and external exposure.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges to open and close, providing access to the cabinet interior.
